نجلنفع (form IIIq)
# نَجْلَنْفِعُ (najlanfiʕu) /nad͡ʒ.lan.fi.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِجْلَنْفَعَ (ijlanfaʕa)
# نَجْلَنْفِعَ (najlanfiʕa) /nad͡ʒ.lan.fi.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِجْلَنْفَعَ (ijlanfaʕa)
# نَجْلَنْفِعْ (najlanfiʕ) /nad͡ʒ.lan.fiʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِجْلَنْفَعَ (ijlanfaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
